messages:
Clara (CS): Heads up — Tidewell just pushed a vendor risk form + proposed DPA amendment. Need quick triage before our onboarding call tomorrow morning.

Jon (Onboarding): Can you attach the form/link? I’ll start mapping to our standard evidence checklist.

Clara (CS): Link: https://files.example.com/tidewell_vrf.pdf. Quick summary from customer: SOC2 attestation requested, EU-only data residency, BYOK for master keys, embeddings retention 90 days, and a 30-day data deletion SLA for exported data.

Ravi (Security): High level: SOC2 fine. EU-only means hosted API likely won’t work for them unless we can guarantee eu-region routing and no cross-region fallbacks. BYOK adds KMS integration overhead but acceptable for Dedicated/Private. 30-day deletion SLA is tighter than our default 60d — flagging for Legal.

Priya (Legal): Noted. The DPA amendment also asks for a subprocessors list and periodic certification updates. We usually commit to 60-day deletion; 30 days may require extra controls or a negotiated exception. I can draft a counter-proposal (45 days) if CS agrees.

Jon (Onboarding): Proposed options to present to customer in the call:
- Hosted (no) — cannot guarantee EU-only + BYOK.
- Dedicated (eu-west) + BYOK — preferred: predictable throughput + KMS integration.
- Private (VPC / on-prem) — fallback if they need absolute network isolation.
I’ll prepare a short ops-runbook and estimate.

Anika (Infra): We support KMS wrapping for Dedicated; customer needs to provide key material/cert chain and KMS config. Note: eu-west Dedicated pools will add ~30-60ms median latency depending on their client region. Also need to confirm HSM vs cloud-KMS requirement.

Clara (CS): Customer wants answers by 10am PST tomorrow. Priya — can Legal entertain a 45-day deletion SLA?

Priya (Legal): We can push to 45 days with a clause about certified deletion procedures and audit right. I’ll draft language and include required subprocessors disclosure cadence.

Ravi (Security): If we go Dedicated+BYOK, security will need the subprocessors list, KMS integration checklist, and confirmation that they accept our standard key-rotation responsibilities. Also: confirm whether embeddings are considered PII in their contract — affects retention.

Clara (CS): Good point about embeddings. I’ll ask the customer to clarify.

Jon (Onboarding): Drafted a short config snippet for the onboarding packet (to be reviewed):

```
model_deployment: "dedicated-eu-west"
kms: {
  mode: "BYOK",
  provider: "customer-kms",
  require_cert_chain: true
}
data_retention: {
  embeddings_days: 90,
  exported_data_deletion_days: 45
}
```

Jon (Onboarding): I’ll attach that to the call notes. Ravi/Anika — if you can sanity-check the checklist by EOD, I’ll send the counter-proposal + ops options to the customer.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot toggled checklist item `DPA signed` -> pending for account `tidewell-prod`.

Clara (CS): Thanks all — I’m on the call in 30m and will update here after the customer responses. :thumbsup:
